digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolver
propositions: Config schema must define three class slots (frontier, standard, trivial) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array, parsed from layered config (CLI > env > file > default) with no api_key field allowed

Resolver must map class name to provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted and defaulting to claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6, and claude-haiku-4-5 for frontier/standard/trivial respectively when slot is unset

Fallback entries must be non-recursive provider targets with model (required), provider (optional, inferred), and endpoint (optional) fields, with api_key forbidden and nested fallback rejected as a typed config error
load_class_slots entry point must read model_classes sub-table from merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and return resolved slots, degrading gracefully to documented defaults when table is absent

Environment variables for class slots must be addressed per-field (REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_<FIELD>) to preserve existing CLI > env > file > default precedence per key, with fallback chain available only through config file pending REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE delivery

Schema implementation must live in new model_classes.py module (not config.py due to 800-line cap) with one-way import edge from config, and docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated and committed with all nine new env vars listed
